name: Should I repair or replace my ejector pump?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my ejector pump?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding whether to repair or replace an ejector pump depends on several factors, including the pump's age, the extent of the damage, and the cost of repairs versus a new unit. If your pump is older than 7-10 years and requires a major component replacement, replacement might be more cost-effective in the long run. Consider the frequency of past repairs; if breakdowns are common, a new pump offers greater reliability. We can provide an assessment to help you weigh the economic and functional tradeoffs of repair versus replacement.
